research.title: A Custom Video Player With Zero JavaScript State, Thanks to Chrome 152
research.whyTrending: Chrome 152 shipped :playing, :paused, :seeking, :buffering, :stalled, :muted and :volume-locked — media state as CSS pseudo-classes, and an Interop 2026 focus area so the other engines are following. Every custom player today syncs state into class names with JavaScript event listeners; this deletes that layer entirely. Caveat worth being honest about: not Baseline yet, so the post needs a real progressive-enhancement path. A build-along with a working player and no state sync at all.
research.gapNote: Carried from 2026-08-16, unpicked. Lowest score here — fun and linkable, but narrow search demand. Must include progressive-enhancement fallback since not Baseline.
